question: What procedure should be followed once knowledge of the mantra has arisen?
premises: Knowledge of the mantra has arisen.
A method involving each name is indicated.
Examination is prescribed as the action.
inference: When mantra knowledge arises, one should examine by each name.
uncertainties: The exact referent of each name is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: When knowledge of the mantra has arisen, one should examine by each name.
